why: Multiple August 2026 preprints report the conjecture refuted: Putman gave 112-vertex counterexamples with SAT-solver certificates, Jooken gave a human-checkable proof, and Goedgebeur/Jooken/Máčajová/Mattiolo/Mazzuoccolo/Ulyanov found 52-vertex counterexamples and infinite families.
queries: Petersen coloring conjecture cubic graph cycle-continuous mapping arXiv 2025
